ValidationRule.description: Restrictions for Dept. Billing Codes with certain Invoice Packages. With Invoice Package 2 or 3 selected, Department Billing Code must be "0-Not Dept Billed". If Invoice Package 1 is selected, the Department Billing Code must be "0-Not Dept Billed".
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (ISPICKVAL(Department_Billing_Code__c, "0-Not Dept Billed") && (ISPICKVAL(Invoice_Package__c, "Invoice Package 2") || ISPICKVAL(Invoice_Package__c, "Invoice Package 3"))) || (ISPICKVAL(Invoice_Package__c, "Invoice Package 1") && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Department_Billing_Code__c, "0-Not Dept Billed")) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Department_Billing_Code__c, "")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Department Billing Code and Invoice Package selected is not valid. 'Invoice Package 1' can only be used with '0-Not Dept Billed' and Invoice Package 2 and 3 cannot be used in conjunction with '0-Not Dept Billed'.
